input.quote: (i) All paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A document-wide search for "insurance" returns no results, and General Matters (sec-20, continuing to p0147) ends with headings without any insurance covenant. Garman personnel attend Authorized Locations for installation and training (sec-4, sec-5) and convert Sparkling's data, so the playbook requires standard coverages. Inserted a new subsection (j) after the last General Matters subsection with CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for processing of Sparkling's data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request; fallback of E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert standard vendor insurance covenant as new General Matters subsection (j)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance provision, yet Garman's personnel attend our sites for installation and training and Garman handles conversion of Sparkling's data, so we have added our standard coverages (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. If USD 5M cyber is not available, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering Garman's access to or processing of Sparkling's data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Garman shall provide Sparkling with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
